subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should the session workspace rail hide/neutralize workspace-external transcript paths, or intentionally expose existence metadata for them?
rationale: The remaining Missing-badge fix can cross from UI state into filesystem metadata semantics, and automation should not choose that security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Hide Or Neutralize External Paths
options.body: Keep raw filesystem metadata inside fs-safe workspace containment and solve the UX by filtering or showing a neutral outside-workspace state.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow the rail to show existence, size, or timestamps for transcript-mentioned external paths only with explicit tests and documented boundary semantics.

recommendation.title: Hide Or Neutralize External Paths
recommendation.body: Keep raw filesystem metadata inside fs-safe workspace containment and solve the UX by filtering or showing a neutral outside-workspace state.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blamed source snapshot and recent workspace-file boundary work make this the best available owner for the fs-safe metadata choice.
